title: Hotel Fact Sheet: Template and Tips to Make It Perfect
summary: Explore our hotel fact sheet design template. See examples, learn the essential elements, and discover best practices for creating a professional overview.
body_markdown:
Your website might have 50 pages of beautiful content, but a busy travel agent or event planner doesn’t have time to peruse them. They just need to know your exact meeting room square footage, your check-in times and whether you have bus parking. That’s where a strong hotel fact sheet comes in — it gives your team a fast, polished way to share only the most important details about your property.


For sales teams, meeting planners, travel advisors and brand partners, a well-designed hotel fact sheet template becomes a go-to resource. It keeps property information consistent, speeds up decision-making and ensures key details are always at their fingertips. In this guide, we’ll provide a template you can download for free.


**Key highlights:**


- A hotel fact sheet is a concise document that summarizes a property’s most important information, including accommodations, amenities, meeting space and contact details.
- Hotel fact sheets give sales teams, event planners and travel partners a quick-reference overview without requiring them to navigate a full website.
- The best hotel fact sheets are visually clean, easy to skim and updated regularly to reflect current offerings and property details.
- Platforms like Canary keep your property's operational info organized while making guest communication seamless from start to finish.


## What Is a Hotel Fact Sheet?


A hotel fact sheet is your property’s cheat sheet. While your website is built for browsing, this document is built for speed, distilling everything a partner needs to know onto a single page.


Ultimately, it’s a tool designed to help travel advisors, event planners and your own sales team evaluate your property in seconds. They’re especially valuable for presentations, RFPs, partnerships and broader marketing initiatives like[social media marketing](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/post/social-media-marketing-strategies-for-hotels) . A standard sheet puts your most critical details front and center:


- The Essentials: Contact info, location and check-in/out times.
- Accommodations: Room counts, bed types and key in-room amenities.
- Spaces: Dining options, meeting rooms and square footage.


## What to Include in a Hotel Fact Sheet


A strong hotel fact sheet template strikes a balance between offering operational clarity and having real marketing appeal. It should give readers the essential details they need at a glance while also showcasing what makes your property memorable, competitive and easy to book.


What to Include in Your Hotel Fact Sheet What to Highlight


**Destination and Access** Property address, nearby airports, transportation options, walkable attractions and key destination highlights


**Room Categories and Capacity** Total room count, suite offerings, maximum occupancy, connecting rooms and accessibility accommodations


**[Property Features](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/post/hotel-amenities) and Services** Dining outlets, spa and wellness amenities, pool access, fitness center, pet policies, parking and Wi-Fi


**Group and Corporate Venues** Meeting room sizes, event capacity, ballroom details, AV capabilities and corporate event services


**Dining and Bar Concepts** Signature restaurants, rooftop bars, room service options, local culinary partnerships and standout dining experiences


**Technology and Guest Experience** Mobile Check-In, Digital Key access, AI-powered guest communication, in-room tech and contactless services


**Brand and Property Story** Unique selling points, design inspiration, property history, sustainability initiatives and guest experience philosophy


**Sales and Booking Contacts** Direct phone numbers, email addresses, website links and dedicated contacts for group sales or partnerships

## Why Fact Sheets Matter for Hotels


Data compiled from thousands of RFPs analyzed by[MeetingBroker](https://www.amadeus-hospitality.com/insight/improve-website-booking-conversion/) revealed a brutal reality for hotel sales teams: 72% of the time, the first hotel to respond to an RFP wins the business.


This means your sales team can't afford to spend hours digging for info or waiting on a manager. A ready-to-go fact sheet allows an instant response, giving the hotel a massive competitive edge.


### They Support Sales and Partnership Outreach


Hotel fact sheets make it easier for sales teams, travel advisors and event planners to quickly evaluate and promote your property. Instead of digging through multiple web pages, partners get the information they need in one polished document.


Key benefits include:


- Faster responses to RFPs and partnership inquiries
- Easier sharing during trade shows and sales presentations
- Clear communication of amenities, meeting space and room inventory
- Stronger positioning for direct bookings and opportunities to[increase hotel revenue](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/use-cases/increase-hotel-revenue)


### They Ensure Brand Consistency Across Channels


A standardized hotel fact sheet keeps property information accurate and consistent across marketing, sales and distribution channels. This reduces confusion and creates a more professional guest-facing brand presence.


A strong fact sheet helps teams:


- Maintain consistent property descriptions and messaging
- Share updated amenities and offerings across departments
- Reduce outdated or conflicting information
- Reinforce brand standards across partner materials and campaigns


### They Simplify Internal Alignment


Fact sheets also serve as an internal operational resource for hotel staff. Teams across sales, marketing, front desk operations and management can reference the same core information, improving communication and efficiency.


Internal advantages include:


- Faster onboarding for new staff members
- Easier coordination between sales and operations teams
- Centralized access to property details and policies
- More confidence when communicating with guests and partners

Having a single source of truth does wonders for your day-to-day operations. Externally, it gives travel agents and event planners the exact data they need to book your hotel without waiting on a slow email reply. Internally, it keeps everyone from the front desk to the executive office aligned. When the logistics are this organized, your team spends less time digging for data and more time delivering great guest experiences.


### It Improves Sales and Group Conversions


Speed and clarity are essential for sales teams and event planners. A detailed hotel fact sheet PDF gives prospects immediate access to the information they need to evaluate your property, making it easier to secure meetings, partnerships and[group bookings](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/post/how-to-increase-hotel-group-bookings) .

- Faster responses to corporate and event inquiries
- Easier comparison against competing properties
- More confidence for travel planners and procurement teams
- Clear visibility into meeting spaces, room blocks and amenities


### It Strengthens Brand Consistency


When every department shares the same approved document, brand messaging stays accurate and consistent across every channel. This creates a more professional experience for guests, partners and stakeholders alike.


A standardized fact sheet supports:


- Consistent property descriptions and visuals
- Unified messaging across sales and marketing materials
- Cleaner communication with OTAs, planners and travel advisors
- Better alignment between on-property teams and corporate offices


### It Reduces Repetitive Inquiries


A strong hotel fact sheet proactively answers many of the most common questions guests and partners ask. This reduces back-and-forth communication and frees up staff to focus on higher-value interactions.


Common efficiencies include:


- Fewer repetitive calls and emails about amenities or policies
- Faster onboarding for new sales and operations staff
- Quicker access to updated property information
- More efficient communication between departments and external partners


## Hotel Fact Sheet Design Samples


How your fact sheet *looks* says as much about your hotel as the text does. If it looks cluttered, partners will assume booking your property is going to be a headache. A clean, thoughtful design acts as a roadmap that helps busy planners find exactly what they need in less than three seconds.


Depending on your property’s vibe, here are a few design styles to consider:


### Minimalist Layout


If your property primarily caters to corporate travelers, business events, or your brand relies on a clean, modern aesthetic, less is definitely more. This style skips the heavy graphics and lets your data do the talking.


- The Palette: Stick one single accent color from your brand to draw the eye to key headers.
- The Structure: Use bold section dividers and crisp tables so a reader can skip straight to what they need, like room counts or square footage.
- The Visuals: Keep images to an absolute minimum (one hero shot of the exterior or a main meeting room keeps the page looking sharp and professional).
- Best For: **** Speeding through corporate RFP responses and cold sales outreach.


### Visual-Forward Layout with Photography


Aesthetics are everything for boutique hotels and luxury resorts. Your fact sheet should evoke the feeling you want guests to have. A visual-forward layout gives partners a taste of the guest experience the second they open the file.


- Go big with photos: Use high-quality, full-width property shots to set the mood right away.
- Sell the experience: Include lifestyle images — guests at the restaurant, a perfectly styled room — rather than just empty architecture.
- Custom touches: Match the color scheme to your hotel's branding, and replace plain text with sleek custom icons.
- Prioritize whitespace: Balance the imagery with plenty of empty space so the layout stays clean, readable and sophisticated.


### Sales-Focused Layout for Events and Corporate Bookings


When a meeting planner is comparing 10 different venues, they’re scanning for numbers. This layout is data-driven, using charts and technical specs to help coordinators instantly verify that your property meets their event requirements.


- Capacities and floor plans: Put room dimensions, ceiling heights and seating configurations front and center.
- Breakout and ballroom details: Clearly differentiate your main event spaces from smaller meeting rooms.
- AV and catering infrastructure: Highlight essential logistics like tech setups, Wi-Fi strength and food capabilities.
- Direct sales contact: Make it easy for planners to take the next step and request an RFP by listing your dedicated group sales contact info.


## Hotel Fact Sheet Format and Design Best Practices


A hotel fact sheet does not need an elaborate design to be effective. Clear organization, strong readability and accurate information matter far more than complex graphics or crowded layouts. The best fact sheets make it easy for readers to quickly find the details they need.


1. Keep it to one page: Prioritize the most important operational, sales and guest-facing details to fit on one page.
2. Use clear section headings: **** Organize information with obvious headers such as accommodations, amenities, meeting space and contact details.
3. Maintain consistent branding: **** Use your hotel’s approved fonts, colors, logo placement and photography style.
4. Ensure updated contact details: Double-check phone numbers, email addresses, booking links and sales contacts regularly.
5. Use high-resolution images: **** Include polished, professional photography that reflects the guest experience and showcases key selling points like guestrooms, event spaces and dining venues.
